accounts.description: Specific accounts to sync. Must be populated if `accountsSyncMode` is set to `SPECIFIC_ACCOUNTS`.

accounts_sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all accounts or specific.

advertisers.description: Specific advertisers to sync. Must be populated if `advertisersSyncMode` is set to `SPECIFIC_ADVERTISERS`.

advertisers_sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all or specific advertisers.

reports.description: The list of reports. Each report corresponds to a table within the schema to which connector syncs the data.

attributes.description: The report attributes included to sync. Labeled `Fields` in the Fivetran dashboard.

custom_column_ids.description: The report custom column IDs included to sync.

metrics.description: The report metrics included to sync.

report_type.description: The type of report. Labeled `Resource type` in the Fivetran dashboard.

rollback_window.description: The custom window size for rollback syncs (between 2 and 90).

segments.description: The report segments included to sync.

table.description: The name of a table within the schema to which connector syncs the data of a given report.

items.description: The list of reports. Each report corresponds to a table within the schema to which connector syncs the data.

timeframe_months.description: Number of months' worth of reporting data you'd like to include in your initial sync. A change of this value will trigger a re-sync for enabled reports during the next connector sync.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Google Search Ads 360 client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Google Search Ads 360 client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
